verdict.rationale: Alma is an immigration law firm offering attorney-led visa services through a client portal, not an AI agent or assistant that could act as an MCP client. Plugging MCP servers in so the product can use their tools is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows Alma ships any agent or tool-calling capability that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
